reason: The invoice breaches three contract rules: (1) Inpatient Metabolic Infusion Therapy is billed with unit_basis "per_hour_per_item" which is not defined (contract allows only per_hour); (2) Postoperative Rheumatologic Anaesthesia Administration applies a 20% uplift despite the service date (2024-10-02) being a Wednesday, not a Saturday/Sunday; (3) Postoperative Dermatologic Physiotherapy Session exceeds its daily cap of 4 units (6 units billed).
